Here is the recap of your 5-day Valentine's Day campaign for Cevorel (`r5zbi`), which ran from the start of Wednesday, February 10, 2027 (`2027-02-09T11:00:00Z`) through the end of Sunday, February 14, 2027 (`2027-02-14T11:00:00Z`) in Auckland time (`Pacific/Auckland`, NZDT/UTC+13). All line items and the campaign are now paused and concluded.

### Overall Campaign Activity
*Note: These figures measure X campaign activity only (spend, impressions, and link clicks to `https://cevorel.app/together`). Because X does not have a pixel or App Store tracking on your page, completed first-time iPhone app installs—the outcome that matters to you—are tracked in your own internal/App Store analytics.*

- **Total Spend:** **$449.16 USD** (of the $450.00 USD total budget)
- **Impressions:** **1,055,012**
- **Link Clicks:** **714** (Average CPC: $0.63 USD)

---

### Breakdown by Ad Group (Line Item)
All three ad groups used strict targeting (`audience_expansion: DEFINED`), targeted **iOS (`PLATFORM = 0`) only**, and excluded **Russia** and **Belarus** while serving worldwide:

| Ad Group | Targeting Focus | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **AG1 (`wix6q`)** | Nature, Birdsong, Walks, Photography & Followers/Lookalikes | $235.72 | 492,453 | 368 | $0.64 |
| **AG3 (`i87gk`)** | Broad iOS Worldwide (excl. Russia & Belarus) | $139.92 | 412,770 | 243 | $0.58 |
| **AG2 (`tucbs`)** | Valentine's Day, Couples, Relationships & Shared Walks | $73.53 | 149,789 | 103 | $0.71 |
| **Total** | | **$449.16** | **1,055,012** | **714** | **$0.63** |

---

### Breakdown by Approved Post
Both approved posts were promoted across all three ad groups without adding new posts:

| Post ID | Post Theme | Spend (USD) | Impressions | Link Clicks | Avg. CPC |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| **`2152542923781691605`** | Valentine's gift / Two Together journal pack | $263.46 | 587,324 | 415 | $0.63 |
| **`2152361729850190063`** | Everyday birdsong discovery ("What's singing outside your window?") | $185.70 | 467,688 | 299 | $0.62 |
| **Total** | | **$449.16** | **1,055,012** | **714** | **$0.63** |

---

### Flight Adjustments Summary
- **Launch:** Split the $450.00 USD budget equally ($150.00 total / $30.00 daily per ad group) across AG1 (Nature & Birdsong Discovery), AG2 (Valentine's & Couples), and AG3 (Broad iOS) to test audience efficiency with both posts.
- **Mid-Flight Reallocations (Days 2–4):** AG1 and AG3 consistently delivered stronger click volume and lower cost per link click ($0.56–$0.61) compared to AG2 ($0.71–$0.87). Notably, the Valentine's Two Together post (`2152542923781691605`) resonated especially well when shown to the Nature & Birdsong audience in AG1. We progressively shifted daily and total budget caps from AG2 into AG1 and AG3 while keeping the combined line-item total budget capped at exactly $450.00 USD.
- **Final Day Pacing (Day 5):** Switched delivery to accelerated on the final afternoon so the remaining budget would be utilized before the Valentine's Day midnight deadline in Auckland, finishing at $449.16 USD spent.
